<function name="IsValidModel" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Checks if the specified model is valid.
 

A model is considered invalid in following cases:
* Starts with a space or **maps**
* Doesn't start with **models**
* Contains any of the following:
  * `_gestures`
  * `_animations`
  * `_postures`
  * `_gst`
  * `_pst`
  * `_shd`
  * `_ss`
  * `_anm`
  * `.bsp`
  * `cs_fix`
* If the model isn't precached on the server, AND if the model file doesn't exist on disk
* If precache failed
* Model is the error model

Running this function will also precache the model. 

	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="modelName" type="string">Name/Path of the model to check.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the model is valid or not. Returns false clientside if the model is not precached by the server.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
